{{Top|leg}}
'''Advent One''' was the designation of a two-seat [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. It was salvaged by [[Scruts]]' outlaws and turned over to an Alliance team who used it to attack the [[Imperial Collection Facility]] processing civilian [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="IAG">''[[Introductory Adventure Game]]''</ref>
